title: Signed sheaf dual coefficient map
statement: Let (C,J) be a site, R a sheaf of commutative rings whose underlying ring sheaf is defined by sheafCompose, L an integer cochain complex of sheaves of R-modules, and g:N→N′ a morphism of R-module sheaves. The coefficient morphism D(L,N)→D(L,N′) of the signed internal dual complex [def-sc-signed-sheaf-dual-complex] is defined in degree k by internal postcomposition with g. It commutes with the signed dual differential.

proof.text: Construct the component at k by homObjMap(id on L^(-k), g). Both composites with the differential equal -(-1)^k times homObjMap(L.d(-(k+1),-k),g), by linearity and homObjMap_comp_homObjMap. CochainComplex.ofHom assembles these components into an actual morphism. No data are selected from an existence theorem.
